run_ocr_text: run ocr_text_cli to extract text from images using the Surya OCR model
run_ocr_text_disable_math: run ocr_text_cli with --disable_math flag to skip math recognition during OCR
run_ocr_text_with_page_range: run ocr_text_cli with --page_range to process specific pages from a multi-page document
run_ocr_text_save_images: run ocr_text_cli with --images flag to save images with detected text bounding boxes drawn on them
run_ocr_text_debug: run ocr_text_cli with --debug flag to log OCR timing and max character count statistics
